log.text: Drop in: chain flips and grabs, and outrun the avalanche
Version 2: a BEST flag on the slope, a run-history chart on the game-over screen, clearer control chips, and it auto-pauses when hidden
Version 3: daily challenge worth ◉120, flips counted, lifetime totals saved, a bar toward the next rider, and safer save loading
Version 4: CLOSE CALL bonuses for skimming over obstacles, a saved best for each sky, game over shows coins to the next rider, plus mute/menu voice commands
Version 5: a ghost replays your longest run beside you, a daily play streak, R to restart instantly, and a tidier title screen on small cards
Version 6: Perfect Landing bonus and speed boost, today's best saved, a Space hint on Drop in, and the streak no longer breaks late at night
Version 7: coin magnet power-up over kickers, a slow-mo 3-2-1 drop-in countdown, magnet timer in the HUD, and an evening 'daily ends tonight' nudge
Version 8: avalanche warning shows meters behind you, last run on the title, shooting stars in night skies, saves no longer overwritten mid-run
Version 9: control tips during early runs, lifetime perfect landings and airtime saved, a time-of-day greeting, a clearer last-run line and stats that scroll
Version 10: same mountain all day, ghost races on its own course, +250 for beating it, combo timer bar, tidier last-run line
Version 11: ↓ carves to slow down with a snow spray, run count saved per rider, ←/→ picks a rider on the title, swipe-grab fix, ghost safe on sync
Version 12: 👻 ghost on/off (G), 🎥 first-person view (V), wider gaps between obstacles early on, warning icons at the screen edge, and top speed builds up more
Version 13 (more AAA first-person, as you asked): sun lens flare in POV, red danger glow on close obstacles, tidy one-line title subtitle
